name: AI cyberattacks
definition: AI-enabled hacking or cyberattacks, including attacks on critical infrastructure.
gdelt: "artificial intelligence" (cyberattack OR cyberattacks OR hackers OR ransomware)
because: AI makes an attack on the grid easier

name: Bioweapons
definition: AI helping create biological, chemical, radiological, or nuclear weapons, or engineered pandemics.
gdelt: "artificial intelligence" (bioweapon OR bioweapons OR "biological weapons" OR biosecurity)
because: AI could help somebody build a weapon

name: AI in schools
definition: AI in classrooms harming students: students using it to cheat or skip the work of learning, AI replacing teachers, or school AI tools collecting students' data.
gdelt: "artificial intelligence" (cheating OR plagiarism) (students OR schools OR college)
because: students are letting AI do the learning

name: AI weapons
definition: AI used to kill or wage war: autonomous weapons that pick targets without a person deciding, or AI running military or nuclear systems.
gdelt: ("autonomous weapons" OR "killer robots" OR "lethal autonomous weapons" OR "AI warfare" OR "AI weapons")
because: a machine could decide who is killed

name: Addictive algorithms
definition: Algorithms built to keep people scrolling: recommendation feeds that hook children or adults, push harmful content, or exploit attention.
gdelt: (algorithm OR algorithms OR "addictive feeds") "social media" (addictive OR addiction) (children OR teens OR kids)
because: the feed is built to hook people

name: AI monopolies
definition: A handful of companies controlling AI, its chips, data or models, and using that control to shut out competitors or dictate terms.
gdelt: "artificial intelligence" (monopoly OR monopolies OR "market concentration" OR "big tech dominance")
because: a few companies will own AI

name: AI bubble
definition: Spending on AI running far ahead of what it earns, so that its collapse takes down markets, banks, or the economy.
because: the AI boom could crash the economy

name: AI slop
definition: Machine-made content flooding feeds, search results and stores, crowding out work made by people.
because: machine-made junk is crowding out people
